$comment: Manifest for a VFX sub-program. The viewer tool reads these; Blender scripts write them. Adding a new effect = add a new directory with one of these.
name: Fire Shield - Strengthen
description: A power-up. The barrier inhales (contracts and dims), detonates outward in a bright ring throwing sparks, then settles at a higher sustained intensity than it started. Distinguishable from an impact by starting quiet and getting brighter.
author: vfx-pipeline

sprite.$comment: resolution is the GAMEPLAY cell. Authoring is 512px and pack_sheets downsamples to 128.

layers.note: Follows the same envelope as the ring.
14 cards driven by a piecewise envelope: inhale 1.0->0.82 (frames 1-8), burst 0.82->1.30 (9-12), settle to 1.06 (13-30). A fast outward kick on frames 9-14 makes the burst read as an explosion.
20 beads snapping outward on the burst.
18 particles thrown outward on the burst with staggered delays 9-12.

envelope.$comment: Piecewise so each phase tunes independently. Values are radius/1.0 and brightness multipliers.

knownIssues: Emission is capped at 1.0 per the rig rule, so brightness above full is expressed by scale and the rim/core rather than by over-driving emission. A consumer wanting a hotter peak would need a second additive pass.
Does not return to idle - it holds at 1.06x. A separate de-buff or transition would be needed to hand back to shield_fire_idle.
